t: This is the obelisk at the centre of St George's Circus in Southwark. It was designed by Robert Mylne, a Scottish architect and civil engineer best remembered for Blackfriars Bridge. Mylne was born and raised in Edinburgh and studied architecture in Rome under Piranesi. In 1758 he became the first Briton to win the triennial architecture competition at the Accademia di San Luca, which made his name known in London and earned him the rivalry of fellow Scot Robert Adam.
